note: Result digests of the synthetic reference games under kernel 2014.5, recorded on October 2, 2026 from the tree before kernel 2014.6 batch B1 (commit b65d257) and reproduced after it. 'digest' is the tests/test_attribution.py ResultIdentityTests projection (final score, possessions, kickoffs, injuries, opening receiver, team counters); 'full_digest' is the sha256 of the whole result (json.dumps with sort_keys, default=str), so a 2014.6 mechanism that leaks into a 2014.5 result anywhere (snap ledger, player lines, diagnostics, labels) fails. Every kernel 2014.6 batch must reproduce this file under PROFILE_2014_5; the 2014.6 digests are recorded once, at the release (B18).
sample_rule: tests/synthetic_games.py: sample_teams(), seed SEED + b'-%05d' % i, event_id 'sample-2013-7-<i>', i < 250
